test_generation: after all 24 pretraining runs and 54 target training selections are frozen
proposal: uniform permutation proposals; reject complete inverse/reverse/complement orbits
rng: numpy.PCG64(SeedSequence([data_seed, role_index, n])); test uses test_seed and role_index=4
generation_order: all training/development pools in repeat, role, length order; test pools last in repeat, length order
historical_exclusion: pilot_v1 through pilot_v5, the canonical platform_v01/dataset, platform_v01 runnable-example objects, and all task_count_v1 training/development/test objects
pairing: all source tasks and all target tasks use the same role-specific objects within a repeat; chains, task counts and token budgets do not alter object pools; the larger budget repeats exposure to this fixed pool
capacity_rule: floor(n!/8) minus occupied historical orbits must cover every requested role across all repeats, including future tests
